##### Project general facts

Tonino Lamborghini Residences by Gulf Land Property Developers is an exclusive residential address located in Nad Al Sheba, where bold design meets refined Italian-inspired aesthetics. The architecture reflects a contemporary vision defined by clean lines, expressive forms, and a strong attention to detail, creating a distinctive identity within one of Dubai’s most prestigious neighborhoods. Each residence is thoughtfully designed to balance visual impact with functionality, delivering living spaces that feel both dynamic and sophisticated.

The development offers a lifestyle shaped by a curated selection of premium amenities designed for comfort, leisure, and everyday convenience. Residents can enjoy private cinema spaces, landscaped green areas, retail and dining options, and family-friendly parks that create a vibrant yet relaxed community environment. The integration of modern infrastructure and smart technologies enhances the overall experience, ensuring seamless living both within the residences and throughout the development.

Interiors are finished with a focus on quality, elegance, and practicality, featuring modern materials and refined detailing throughout. Apartments include fully fitted kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and well-planned layouts that maximize usability and comfort. Residences are delivered unfurnished, providing the flexibility to personalize each space while benefiting from a strong foundation of premium finishes and contemporary design.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
